main_body: Tall brick townhouse facade with two window rows, balcony and a shopfront awning, under a slate mansard roof with two dormers
top_band: Grey-teal flat-roof band at rows ~10-17, with a dark outline, sitting behind the slate. It is a thin strip above a front-facing slate wall, not a roof surface seen from above.
evidence: Reading one column down the middle: a short grey-teal band (rows 10-17), then the slate mansard (rows ~18-42), an orange cornice strip (43-46), and the brick facade from 47 to 140. The mansard is drawn as a vertical scalloped face, and the cornice is only a 3-4 row strip with no eave shadow. Everything below is a flat frontal elevation of windows, balcony and awning. The references show large visible roof slopes, and this has none, so it reads as a front elevation with a thin roof hat.

style.evidence: The brick has about 5-6 tones with per-brick highlights and mortar variation. The slate has several blue-grey steps with scalloped rows. The windows show warm glow dots, the awning has stripes, and the stonework is speckled. Outlines lean dark brown and dark blue-grey beside their materials rather than being neutral black. Every tile is dense with colours and there are no large flat fills, so it matches the reference's richness.
